svg.text: Read top to bottom. Numbers in brackets are instance counts for the N_STACK = 4 baseline.
shipped for YOUR fabric, not instantiated here
hbm4_addr_slice shares one RTL source with the controller's decode, and a formal
miter proves they agree. A silent disagreement here corrupts memory with no error.
